([[Chattanooga, Tennessee]]) * [[Link Academy (Missouri)|Link Academy]]
([[Branson, Missouri]]) | college = * [[Ohio State Buckeyes men's basketball|Ohio State]] (2022–2024) * [[Tennessee Volunteers basketball|Tennessee]] (2024–2026) | draft_year = 2026 | draft_round = 2 | draft_pick = 46 | draft_team = [[Orlando Magic]] | career_start = 2026 | years1 = {{nbay|2026|start}}–present | team1 = [[Washington Wizards]] | years2 = [[2025–26 NBA G League season|2026]]–present | team2 = →[[Capital City Go-Go]] | highlights = * [[Southeastern Conference|SEC]] All-Defensive Team (2026) }} '''Felix Eberechukwu Okpara'''{{Audio|Ig-Felix Okpara.ogg|Listen|help=no}} (born April 20, 2004) is a Nigerian professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Washington Wizards]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA), on a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Capital City Go-Go]] of the [[NBA G League]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Ohio State Buckeyes men's basketball|Ohio State Buckeyes]] and [[Tennessee Volunteers basketball|Tennessee Volunteers]]. ==Early life== Okpara was born in [[Lagos]], Nigeria, where he played [[association football|soccer]] during his early years as a central and defensive [[midfielder]].{{cite web |last1=Jordan |first1=Jason |title=2022 Center Felix Okpara Thrives as an Elite Shot Blocker |url=https://www.si.com/college/recruiting/basketball/felix-okpara-elite-shot-blocker-st-james-nibc-2022-center |website=Sports Illustrated |access-date=April 7, 2024 |date=January 12, 2021}} At the age of 14, Okpara moved to the [[United States]] to pursue a basketball career, having never played basketball before.{{cite web |last1=Jardy |first1=Adam |title=After latest move, 'adaptable' Felix Okpara working to settle in as Ohio State Buckeye |url=https://www.dispatch.com/story/sports/college/basketball/2022/10/21/ohio-state-basketball-felix-okpara-working-to-settle-in-at/69577291007/ |website=The Columbus Dispatch |access-date=April 7, 2024 |date=October 21, 2022}} He initially attended Hamilton Heights Christian Academy, where he averaged 11.9 points, 7.9 rebounds, and 2.6 blocks per game, and also blocked double-digit shots in two game; one game being the St. James NIBC Invitational against [[Oak Hill Academy (Virginia)|Oak Hill Academy]] where he blocked 12 shots.{{cite web |last1=Jordan |first1=Jason |title=Jalen Duren, Kennedy Chandler, Felix Okpara and Others Shine at the St. James NIBC Invitational |url=https://www.si.com/college/recruiting/basketball/jalen-duren-kennedy-chandler-stars-shine-at-st-james-nibc-invitational |website=Sports Illustrated |access-date=April 7, 2024 |date=January 11, 2021}}{{cite web |last1=Jardy |first1=Adam |title=Ohio State men's basketball power rankings: No. 10 Felix Okpara |url=https://www.dispatch.com/story/sports/college/basketball/2022/10/19/ohio-state-basketball-felix-okpara-power-rankings-number-10/69570285007/ |website=The Columbus Dispatch |access-date=January 31, 2024 |date=October 19, 2022}} As a reserve his senior year, he averaged 8 points, 6 rebounds, and 2 blocks per game, helping his team reach the GEICO Nationals where he had 4 points, 4 rebounds, and 4 blocks in their loss to [[Montverde Academy]]. He received offers from [[Florida Gators men's basketball|Florida]], [[Georgia Bulldogs men's basketball|Georgia]], [[Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball|Illinois]], [[Mississippi State Bulldogs men's basketball|Mississippi State]], [[Nebraska Cornhuskers men's basketball|Nebraska]], [[Ohio State Buckeyes men's basketball|Ohio State]], [[Oklahoma Sooners men's basketball|Oklahoma]], [[Oklahoma State Cowboys basketball|Oklahoma State]], [[Ole Miss Rebels men's basketball|Ole Miss]], [[San Diego Toreros men's basketball|San Diego]], [[Tennessee Volunteers men's basketball|Tennessee]], [[Texas Longhorns men's basketball|Texas]], and [[Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball|Vanderbilt]], before committing to play at Ohio State on July 26, 2021.{{cite web |last1=Hass-Hill |first1=Colin |title=FOUR-STAR CENTER FELIX OKPARA COMMITS TO OHIO STATE |url=https://www.elevenwarriors.com/ohio-state-basketball-recruiting/2021/07/123766/four-star-center-felix-okpara-commits-to-ohio-state |website=Eleven Warriors |access-date=March 2, 2024 |date=July 26, 2021}} ===Recruiting=== Okpara was ranked the 74th best player in the nation, the 15th best center in the nation, and the 4th best player in the state of [[Missouri]] in the class of 2022. career== ===Ohio State=== In the Buckeyes' 96–59 win over [[2022–23 Saint Francis Red Flash men's basketball team|Saint Francis]] on December 3, 2022, Okpara achieved his first career [[double-double]], and also hit his first career [[Three-point field goal|three]].{{cite web |last1=Jardy |first1=Adam |title=Felix Okpara, balanced freshman attack highlight Ohio State's win against St. Francis |url=https://www.dispatch.com/story/sports/college/basketball/2022/12/03/behind-felix-okpara-fellow-freshmen-ohio-state-cruises-to-win/69697632007/ |website=The Columbus Dispatch |access-date=March 2, 2024 |date=December 4, 2022}} Okpara, who had been dealing with an injury, played 8 minutes in the team's 72–60 win over [[2022–23 Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball team|Illinois]] on February 26, 2023.{{cite web |last1=Smith |first1=Casey |title=Ohio State 'Nursing' Injury With C Felix Okpara |url=https://www.si.com/college/ohiostate/news/ohio-state-buckeyes-nursing-injury-with-center-felix-okpara-zed-key-eugene-brown-iii |website=Buckeyes Now |access-date=March 3, 2024 |date=March 1, 2023}} In the final 9 games of the season, Okpara averaged 5.8 points and 4.4 rebounds per game, along with shooting a solid 63.2% from the floor after starting center [[Zed Key]] was ruled out for the rest of the season.{{cite web |last1=Helwagen |first1=Steve |title=Watch: Felix Okpara ready to make his mark at center for basketball Buckeyes |url=https://247sports.com/college/ohio-state/longformarticle/ohio-state-buckeyes-mens-basketball-center-felix-okpara-ready-to-take-over-as-starter-219306434/ |website=Bucknuts |access-date=March 10, 2024 |date=November 1, 2023}} On March 1, Okpara had his best game of the season, tallying 12 points, 12 rebounds, and 3 blocks in a 73–62 upset win over No. 21 [[2022–23 Maryland Terrapins men's basketball team|Maryland]].{{cite web |title=Felix Okpara fuels Ohio State basketball in 73-62 win over No. 21 Maryland |url=https://www.cleveland.com/osu/2023/03/felix-okpara-fuels-ohio-state-in-73-62-win-over-no-21-maryland.html |website=Cleveland.com |access-date=April 7, 2024 |date=March 1, 2023}} In the quarterfinals of the [[2023 Big Ten men's basketball tournament|Big Ten tournament]], Okpara notched 8 points, 8 rebounds, and 5 blocks in the 68–58 win over [[2022–23 Michigan State Spartans men's basketball team|Michigan State]]. On November 29, 2023, in the 88–61 win against [[2023–24 Central Michigan Chippewas men's basketball team|Central Michigan]], Okpara notched a career-high 14 points.{{cite web |last1=Kruskevich |first1=Gaston |title=MEN'S BASKETBALL: FELIX OKPARA'S "BIGGER, STRONGER AND MORE EXPLOSIVE" BODY TRANSFORMATION JOURNEY |url=https://www.thelantern.com/2023/12/mens-basketball-felix-okparas-bigger-stronger-and-more-explosive-body-transformation-journey/ |website=The Lantern |access-date=February 29, 2024 |date=December 27, 2023}} After the season, Okpara announced his return to the Buckeyes. However, on April 21, 2024, Okpara decided to enter the transfer portal.{{cite web |last1=Jardy |first1=Adam |title=After pledging Ohio State return, Felix Okpara changes course, enters transfer portal |url=https://www.dispatch.com/story/sports/college/basketball/2024/04/21/ohio-states-felix-okpara-changes-course-enters-transfer-portal/73402759007/ |website=The Columbus Dispatch |access-date=April 23, 2024 |date=April 21, 2024}} ===Tennessee=== On April 25, 2024, Okpara transferred to [[Tennessee Volunteers basketball|Tennessee]].{{cite web |last1=Wilson |first1=Mike |title=Felix Okpara commits to Tennessee basketball as Ohio State transfer |url=https://www.knoxnews.com/story/sports/college/university-of-tennessee/mens-basketball/2024/04/25/felix-okpara-tennessee-basketball-commit-transfer-portal-ohio-state/73406296007/ |website=Knoxville News Sentinel |access-date=April 28, 2024 |date=April 25, 2024}} He posted 7.1 points and 6.4 rebounds per game during his first season and junior season at [[2024–25 Tennessee Volunteers basketball team|Tennessee]] in [[2024–25 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2024–25]].{{cite web |last1=Wilson |first1=Mike |title=Rick Barnes updates Felix Okpara's injury for Tennessee basketball after Auburn win |url=https://www.on3.com/teams/tennessee-volunteers/news/felix-okpara-injury-update-tennessee-basketball-auburn-rick-barnes/ |website=On3 |access-date=May 14, 2026 |date=January 31, 2026}} Okpara averaged 8.0 points, 6.3 rebounds and 1.5 blocks per game in his final and senior season in [[2025–26 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2025–26]].{{cite web |last1=Ramey |first1=Grant |title=Where Felix Okpara, Ja'Kobi Gillespie are projected in new ESPN NBA mock draft |url=https://www.on3.com/teams/tennessee-volunteers/news/tennessee-vols-basketball-nba-mock-draft-espn-felix-okpara-jakobi-gillespie/ |website=On3 |access-date=July 20, 2026 |date=May 14, 2026}}
